english: In a triangle $ABC$, $BC=8$ and the length of the median $AD$ is $\sqrt{34}$. The internal and the external bisectors of the angle $BAC$ meet the line $BC$ at the points $P$ and $Q$, respectively, and $PQ=6$. Then the area of the triangle $ABC$ is ______.
hindi: एक त्रिभुज $ABC$ में $BC=8$ है तथा माध्यिका $AD$ की लम्बाई $\sqrt{34}$ है। कोण $BAC$ के आन्तरिक तथा बाह्य समद्विभाजक रेखा $BC$ को क्रमशः बिन्दुओं $P$ तथा $Q$ पर मिलते हैं, तथा $PQ=6$ है। तब त्रिभुज $ABC$ का क्षेत्रफल ______ है।
solution: Let $k=\dfrac{AB}{AC}$ ($k\neq1$ as $Q$ exists). $P$, $Q$ divide $BC$ internally and externally in $k:1$ (harmonic conjugates of $B,C$)
solution_full: Let $k=\dfrac{AB}{AC}$. The external bisector meets line $BC$ only if $AB\neq AC$, so $k\neq1$.
By the bisector theorems, $\dfrac{PB}{PC}=\dfrac{QB}{QC}=k$: $P$ divides $BC$ internally and $Q$ externally in the ratio $k:1$, so $P,Q$ are harmonic conjugates with respect to $B,C$.
Place $BC$ on a number line with $B=0$, $C=8$. Section formula: $P=\dfrac{k\cdot8+1\cdot0}{k+1}=\dfrac{8k}{k+1}$, $Q=\dfrac{k\cdot8-1\cdot0}{k-1}=\dfrac{8k}{k-1}$.
For $k<1$: $\dfrac{16k}{1-k^2}=6\Rightarrow3k^2+8k-3=0\Rightarrow(3k-1)(k+3)=0\Rightarrow k=\dfrac13$. For $k>1$ the same equation gives $k=3$; the two cases are mirror images (swap $B$ and $C$).
originality_note: New: the ratio AB : AC is hidden in the distance between the feet of the two bisectors of angle A (harmonic conjugates of B, C), and the median length then fixes the scale (way 5: harmonic division and Apollonius' median formula). Closest known: 'median length from the sides' and 'the circle on PQ as diameter is the Apollonius circle'. Different because: PQ must first be converted to the ratio k through internal and external division before the median formula can be used.
stem_review: Read as a student: every point, side, angle and symbol is introduced before use, all conditions are stated, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked that both k = 1/3 and k = 3 give the same area, so the answer is unique. Changed: No change.
key_step: Converting PQ = 6 into AB : AC = 1 : 3 through internal and external division of BC.
justification: Two linked ideas (harmonic division by the two bisectors, then the median formula) and a final area computation; numerical answer with a quadratic in k. Above 2021-P1-Q18 (L2), comparable to the average Advanced two-idea questions such as 2021-P2-Q2 (L3).

concept_use.Length of median: AB^2 + AC^2 = 2AD^2 + BC^2/2 = 100 gives AB and AC once k is known.
concept_use.Distance formula, Section formula, harmo: P and Q divide BC internally and externally in k : 1 (harmonic conjugates); their positions and the distance PQ give k = 1/3.
